name: Rocicorp Node workspace + sibling Compose services
description: Node.js dev container that runs the repo's existing docker-compose services (e.g. Postgres) as sibling containers. The workspace reaches them over the Compose network by service name but has no Docker daemon and no host Docker socket.

appName.description: Workspace folder name, typically the repo name (mounted at /workspaces/<appName>).

nodeVersion.description: Node.js major version for the workspace image.

servicesComposeFile.description: Repo-relative path to the existing Compose file that defines the local services.

dbService.description: Name of the database service in that Compose file (used for depends_on).
